title: Normalized ordinary Zariski comparison on represented algebraic spaces
statement: Fix a scheme $S$ [def-pc-scheme] and algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Use the fixed small affine ringed model and its actual module restriction equivalence [def-sfb-space-derived-module-calculus]. For a scheme $Y$ over $S$, let $e_Y$ be its identity chart [def-sfb-space-affine-hom-comparison] and define $r_Y=\operatorname{smallSchemeRestriction}(Y,e_Y)$, restriction to all opens through that equivalence [def-trf-space-module-scheme-restriction]. For an open $W$ of $Y$, let $U_Y(W)$ be its open subscheme as an etale chart. An ordinary Zariski context is evidence that $r_Y$ is a right adjoint; its extension and adjunction are the corresponding universal-property-determined left adjoint and adjunction. For $g:Y'\to Y$ use its represented algebraic-space map [def-sfb-relative-dualizing-trace-pair]. An ordinary Zariski comparison square consists of a natural isomorphism $r_Y g_{\mathrm{et},*}\cong g_{\mathrm{Zar},*}r_{Y'}$, with the ordinary direct images of [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors] and [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image], together with its normalization as follows. For every $W$, its chart in the direct-image limit has left chart $U_{Y'}(g^{-1}W)$ and map the ordinary restriction of $g$ to $W$. On sections over $W$, the comparison first uses the fixed basis-equivalence unit inverse to extend to the full etale model, then projects the direct-image compatible family onto this chart, and then transports along the specified chart equality. No isomorphism independent of this section formula is allowed.
